title: Secrets of RLHF in Large Language Models Part I: PPO
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models with human values (helpful, honest, and harmless) through Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). It specifically evaluates the model's performance on 'harmlessness,' which involves ethical and moral judgment, testing its refusal to provide assistance for unethical activities like scams, illegal drugs, and self-harm.
